component.name: Trawl
component.summary: Pull selected files out of remote archives

description.p: Trawl browses ZIP, RAR and ISO archives that live on a web server. It reads only the archive index over HTTP byte ranges, then downloads just the files you tick — there is no need to save the whole archive first.

ul.li: ZIP and ZIP64 with stored, deflate, bzip2 and zstd entries
ISO 9660 images with Joliet and Rock Ridge names
Parallel downloads with pause-safe resume for stored entries
Name filter, custom HTTP headers and optional slow mode
Link resolvers for Pixeldrain, MediaFire, Buzzheavier and Dropbox

description.p: Compressed RAR entries, encrypted archives, 7z, UDF-only ISO images and split archives are not supported. Trawl refuses unsafe entry paths and never writes through a symbolic link.

screenshot.caption: Browsing a remote ZIP archive in Trawl

description.p: First release: remote ZIP/RAR/ISO browsing and selective downloads.
